finding.headline: "The Faith-Friend Isolation Mum"
finding.problem: "Church was my family here. Now I'm home alone Sunday afternoon, and I don't even know who to text. I feel far from God and from everyone."
finding.person: Diaspora mum whose only real community was her church friends; now she can't make midweek fellowships or Saturday events and feels cut off from her spiritual village.
